decisions.question: What should an empty graph name mean?
decisions.decision: An empty graph name never means "take the first graph". MUTATING tools refuse it with graph_name_required. READER and ANALYSIS tools treat it as "every graph in the asset" and must name each graph scanned, setting complete=false if any graph could not be read. Asset-wide scanning is an explicit iteration at the call site; TurboMCPNodeId::FindGraphByName keeps refusing an empty name.
